description: Gujarat accelerates modern policing through Project Vishwas, integrating 12,500 new CCTV cameras and advanced command centers statewide
body_lead: Gujarat, home to global landmarks such as the Narendra Modi Stadium and the Statue of Unity, is preparing to add another milestone to its development journey as it gears up to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games. In alignment with Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision for technologically empowered governance, the Gujarat Police has completed the second phase of the ambitious Project Vishwas — a statewide modern surveillance and security enhancement initiative.
